title: POST /v1/gateway-deployments request body (as-built)
description: Derived from TelephonyApp.create_gateway_deployment (src/telephony_ai/app.py:9175). organization_id and project_id are the only hard-required keys (KeyError -> 500 today if missing). mode defaults to the deployment model's gateway_mode or 'self_hosted'. charge_wallet defaults to true; the self_hosted_gateway plan has a 0 monthly base so self-hosted creation does not require wallet balance.

deployment_model_id.description: Optional. Resolved by resolve_deployment_model (src/telephony_ai/pricing.py). The fully_self_hosted_byo_provider option was removed at M3 (see docs/BYO_DIDWW_DISPOSITION.md).

carrier_account_id.description: Defaults to the deployment model's carrier account or 'managed_didww_resale'. Known values: sandbox_fake_provider, managed_didww_resale, byo_didww_account, self_managed_provider.

provider.description: Provider key for the auto-attached provider account; defaults to 'didww'.

provider_account_id.description: Attach an existing provider account instead of auto-creating one.

charge_wallet.description: Defaults to true. When true and the plan has a monthly base fee, a gateway_monthly usage record is charged to the wallet at creation.
